name: Mouth Jamboree
description: A squeezed-half-flat tube of Mouth Jamboree kids' toothpaste, now with terrible advice: ask Dr. Toothbert anything, read the Jam Facts and the Cavity Patrol tips, and find the eight sad, rotten teeth hiding around the tube to earn a Certificate of Ateethment.

spots.label: The dollop on top
spots.title: Cavity Patrol Tip
spots.say: Use a pea-sized amount. We measured it against a very large pea. A pea about the size of a toaster.

spots.label: A sad tooth (Molar Dave)
spots.title: You found Molar Dave
spots.say: I live in the threads now. The gel never comes for me. It's fine. I'm fine. ({found} of {total} sad teeth found.)

spots.label: A sad tooth (Canine Carol)
spots.title: You found Canine Carol
spots.say: Everyone wants to be a front tooth. I'm a side tooth. Nobody photographs the side. ({found} of {total} sad teeth found.)

spots.label: A sad tooth (Wisdom Pete)
spots.title: You found Wisdom Pete
spots.say: They took my brothers out in 2009. I've been wise ever since. Wise and alone. ({found} of {total} sad teeth found.)

spots.label: A sad tooth (Crown Craig)
spots.title: You found Crown Craig
spots.say: I'm a crown. Not the fun kind. The kind they glue on. ({found} of {total} sad teeth found.)

spots.label: A sad tooth (Incisor Greg)
spots.title: You found Incisor Greg
spots.say: The Dental Association accepted the toothpaste. They did not accept me. ({found} of {total} sad teeth found.)

spots.label: A sad tooth (Bicuspid Linda)
spots.title: You found Bicuspid Linda
spots.say: I tried to ride the swoosh. It didn't go anywhere. That's the thing about swooshes. ({found} of {total} sad teeth found.)

menu.title: Dr. Toothbert says
menu.say: Twice a year. Once on your birthday, and once on the birthday of someone you respect.

menu.title: Dr. Toothbert says
menu.say: Fill the brush, then keep going. If you can still see the brush, you're not committed.

menu.title: Dr. Toothbert says
menu.say: Floss is just spaghetti that gave up. Use real spaghetti. Cooked. Al dente, for grip.

menu.title: Dr. Toothbert says
menu.say: Until the song ends. Any song. A really long song if you had a big lunch.

menu.title: Dr. Toothbert says
menu.say: Gargle with orange juice. It has vitamin C. C stands for Cavities. Wait. Hold on.

menu.text: When do I get a new toothbrush?
menu.title: Dr. Toothbert says
menu.say: When the old one starts giving you advice. Mine started last year. It's how we met.

menu.text: Do I need a real dentist?
menu.title: Dr. Toothbert says
menu.say: I'm a dentist. Mostly. I have a coat. Look at the coat.

menu.locked: You've found {found} of {total} sad teeth. They're hiding all over the tube: the cap, the label, the shoulders, the confetti. Find all of them first.
menu.title: Certificate of Ateethment
menu.say: This certifies that you found all eight sad, rotten teeth and listened to every one of them. They still need a real dentist. But they feel seen. Your certificate is pinned to the tube.

menu.title: Back in hiding
menu.say: The sad teeth went back to their hiding places. They prefer it there. The certificate is back in the drawer.

menu.title: Cavity Patrol Tip
menu.say: If you can't see the cavity, it can't see you. Keep your mouth closed at all times. Even while eating.

menu.title: Cavity Patrol Tip
menu.say: Caramel is fine as long as you chew it on the side of your mouth you don't use.

menu.title: Cavity Patrol Tip
menu.say: Brush in a circle, then the other circle, to undo the first circle. Teeth respect balance.

menu.title: Cavity Patrol Tip
menu.say: Brushing before bed wakes the teeth up. Let them sleep. Brush after breakfast, lunch, or never.

spots.label: Certificate of Ateethment
spots.title: Certificate of Ateethment
spots.say: Awarded for finding all eight sad, rotten teeth and listening to every one of them. Signed, Dr. Toothbert, D.D.S. (Definitely Didn't Study). Frame it. Do not brush it.

spots.label: A sad tooth (Baby Tooth Timmy)
spots.title: You found Baby Tooth Timmy
spots.say: The Tooth Fairy came. She looked at me for a long time. She left a nickel and a pamphlet. ({found} of {total} sad teeth found.)

spots.label: A sad tooth (Premolar Ron)
spots.title: You found Premolar Ron
spots.say: I'm almost a molar. I've been almost a molar for thirty years. ({found} of {total} sad teeth found.)

facts.title: Jam Facts: Directions
rows: Then brush in the other circle
The bubbles get into the hard-to-reach places
Store your brush in the garden
Nobody will answer, but it's nice to call
facts.note: Mouth Jamboree is not a real toothpaste and none of this is real advice. Brush twice a day and see an actual dentist.
